title: LLM API Pricing 2026: Full Comparison Table (Weekly)
description: LLM API pricing 2026: 43 models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, and Mistral in one table. Input/output cost per 1M tokens, updated weekly.

attribution.citation: Json House, "LLM API Pricing 2026: Full Comparison Table (Weekly)", jsonhouse.com (2026-08-24)

key_facts.fact: DeepSeek raised v4-flash from $0.14/$0.28 to $0.22/$0.66 per 1M tokens on 2026-08-17, a 57% input and 136% output increase that ended its run as the cheapest maintained general-purpose LLM API; Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite ($0.10/$0.40) takes the title
key_facts.source: DeepSeek and Google pricing pages, retrieved 2026-08-17

key_facts.fact: Anthropic cancelled the scheduled 2026-09-01 increase of Claude Sonnet 5 from $2/$10 to $3/$15 per 1M tokens; the introductory rate became the standard price
Claude Fable 5 launched at $10 input / $50 output per 1M tokens, double the price of Claude Opus 4.8 ($5/$25)

Anthropic's newer models (Claude Opus 4.7 and later, Sonnet 5, Fable 5) use a tokenizer that produces approximately 30% more tokens for the same text, making per-token prices non-comparable with earlier Claude models and other providers

Standard cache-read discounts are 90% of input price at Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google, and 96.8% at DeepSeek ($0.007 per 1M cache-hit tokens off a $0.22 base) as of 2026-08-17, down from 98% before DeepSeek's increase
key_facts.source: Official pricing pages of Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, retrieved 2026-08-17

key_facts.fact: Long-context pricing structures diverged and OpenAI switched sides on 2026-08-24: Google and xAI bill roughly 2x per token above 200K-token prompts, GPT-5.6-sol now bills $8.00/$30.00 on long context against a $4.00/$20.00 base, and Anthropic alone still bills its full 1M-token context window at standard rates
key_facts.source: Google, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic pricing pages, retrieved 2026-08-24

key_facts.fact: The LLM API market is splitting: frontier prices are rising (Fable 5 at 2x Opus, OpenAI pro models at $30/$180) while sub-frontier prices continue to deflate
key_facts.source: jsonhouse analysis of official pricing pages, 2026-07-16

key_facts.fact: Mistral repositioned its former flagship Mistral Large 3 at $0.50/$1.50 per 1M tokens — one third the price of the newer Mistral Medium 3.5 ($1.50/$7.50)

OpenAI cut GPT-5.6-sol 20% on input and 33% on output to $4.00 / $20.00 on 2026-08-24, a promotional rate stated as available at least through 2026-11-21; earlier cuts on 2026-08-03 took GPT-5.6-luna down 80% to $0.20 / $1.20 and GPT-5.6-terra down 20% to $2.00 / $12.00, neither of which moved this week
Claude Opus 5 launched at $5 input / $25 output per 1M tokens — the same price as Opus 4.5 through 4.8, so the generational step carried no price increase

faq_summary.q: What is the cheapest LLM API in 2026?
faq_summary.a: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite at $0.10 input / $0.40 output per 1M tokens. DeepSeek v4-flash held the title until 2026-08-17, when DeepSeek raised it to $0.22 / $0.66. DeepSeek still leads on cached input at $0.007 per 1M tokens.

faq_summary.q: Is Claude Sonnet 5's price going up on September 1, 2026?
faq_summary.a: No. Anthropic cancelled the increase. The $2/$10 introductory rate is now the standard price and the scheduled move to $3/$15 will not occur.

faq_summary.q: Are per-token prices directly comparable across providers?
faq_summary.a: Only approximately. Anthropic's newest models tokenize the same text into roughly 30% more tokens than earlier Claude models, so identical sticker prices can produce different invoices. Compare cost per task, not cost per token.

faq_summary.q: Do these prices include long-context surcharges?
faq_summary.a: No — base tiers only. Google and xAI roughly double rates above 200K-token prompts; Anthropic bills its 1M context at standard rates.

faq_summary.q: How often is this table updated?
faq_summary.a: Weekly, from official provider pages only, with every change recorded in the changelog. Missed weeks are marked as gaps rather than back-filled: the 2026-07-20 and 2026-07-27 snapshots were not taken. The series began 2026-07-16.
